method.environment: Real live website DOM, page scripts and safe navigation; extension APIs mocked; content and detector injected after load.
method.comparison: Two alternating observer/auto 800ms scrolling samples per route; baseline/auto order alternates per sample.
method.metrics: MutationObserver callbacks/records, TreeWalker node visits, scheduled tasks and discovery CPU. Does not measure total page load, whole-page CPU, input latency or installed-extension startup.
method.controls: Followed real internal links, exercised menus, table of contents, search, comment collapse and disclosures; no accounts, messages, purchases or other external mutations.
method.fontProbe: Three actual Lexend font buffers loaded. Computed-family coverage initially reported by probe is not sufficient to prove glyph loading; HN and Kernel CSS data URLs were blocked, so visual retests suppressed six mocked CSS @font-face declarations and used buffered faces.

summary.breakage: No functional or layout regression observed on inspected routes/controls. Headings/code protected, no horizontal document overflow recorded. This is sampled coverage, not exhaustive website inspection.
summary.performance: 20/21 routes had zero discovery CPU/callbacks/visits in both paths during measured scrolling, so no demonstrated steady-state speedup. One RFC article observer sample used 1.2ms and the other 0ms, versus auto both0. RFC search author expansion single comparison used observer1callback/4visits/0.2ms vs auto0, a real but small saved cost.

exclusions.reason: HTTP403 Forbidden; excluded from coverage and replaced with Debian.
Real search link followed and huge full text page loaded. Instrumented comparison exceeded 15s browser tool timeout; no performance result counted. Replaced with RFC explanatory article route.

limitations: Not an installed extension; no genuine document_start, isolated-world bridge, browser chrome or Firefox behavior validated here.
Only sampled representative routes and controls; cannot inspect every page of these websites.
Sites change; URLs/titles and raw comparisons reflect this run. DOM sizes can change between visits.

Multiple T3 clients intermittently targeted stale same-tab documents, even after exclusive browser ownership. Wrong-URL attempts were discarded. All retained comparisons have expected URLs and three loaded font buffers. Successful snapshots saved for all7sites.
Measured scrolling samples are short and low-resolution CPU results near0 are noisy. Do not translate discovery savings into page-load speedup or user-visible latency gains.
The initial probe captures protected nodes at injection; on RFC SPA navigations detached initial nodes limit changedProtected coverage, so interior screenshot inspection supplemented it.
No page in this ordinary-site batch used an open shadow root; shadow mode covered separately by another agent.
